question: What eightfold attainment of siddhi is identified with mūlakaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: Siddhi attainment is linked to mūlakaula.

uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of the compound remains unclear.
plain_english: And eight, O fair-faced one, is the attainment of siddhi, mūlakaula.
